# Contributing

This repository does not accept pull requests from external contributors. All changes are made by the core team to keep the MPP SDKs consistent with each other and with the specification. Pull requests from external contributors are closed automatically.

## Opening an issue

To report a problem or request a change, [open an issue](https://github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-rs/issues/new/choose) and select a type:

- **Bug**: something is broken. Include the SDK version, a minimal reproduction, and the expected behavior.
- **Feature request**: functionality the SDK does not yet provide.
- **Inconsistency**: behavior that differs from another MPP SDK or from the [specification](https://github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-specs).
- **Documentation**: errors or gaps in the README, documentation, or examples.

If example code would help, push it to a branch on your fork and link it in the issue.

We review and triage every issue. Pull requests that address an issue link to it and credit its author. If your code is used, you are added as a co-author.

## Questions

Ask questions in the [MPP Developers Telegram group](https://t.me/mpp_devs).

## Security

Do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues. [Report them privately](https://github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-rs/security/advisories/new) instead.

## Protocol changes

Changes to the protocol belong in [tempoxyz/mpp-specs](https://github.com/tempoxyz/mpp-specs), which accepts pull requests.
